08.06.retained_privacy_and_boundaries: Use a private task label and structured start indicators only. Do not store task contents, health information, diagnoses, employer or client information, another person's identity, or reasons for low motivation. Do not force action through fatigue, depression, disability, caregiving load, pain, illness, sleep need, fear, coercion, or lack of resources. This is not treatment, diagnosis, productivity monitoring, or proof of character.

09.12.retained_privacy_and_boundaries: Omit names, contact details, secrets, credentials, allegations, legal privilege, health details, protected work information, financial account data, sensitive third-party detail, and the substantive contents of the decision. Store only allowlisted criterion IDs and neutral codes in typed evidence; artifact contents never enter evidence. Do not use the record to monitor another person, justify predetermined harm, or substitute for qualified advice.

10.02.retained_privacy_and_boundaries: Use synthetic or non-sensitive material. Evidence stores only criterion IDs, bounded indicators, and minimal provenance—not recordings, artifact contents, prose, observer identity, student or client data, or workplace material. Feedback may be self-generated and never requires another person, public posting, humiliation, abusive instruction, or unlicensed practice.

13.02.retained_privacy_and_boundaries: Keep working notes private. Record only the listed observation checks, not document contents, identifying details or another person's private information. Participation and any help must be voluntary. Use a seated reach, tactile marker, clear label or shared reminder. Reducing the routine to a single ready item may be more useful than reorganizing a whole room.
